description: Add a library entry to the project as a new plugin, a full copy of its latest version, and return the plugin. The server only is changed: no local file is written and nothing is installed (run `npx @athenode/cli init --plugin <id or slug>` to install it, both of which are in the result). A name the project already uses is refused with code `plugin_name_conflict` and a free `suggestedName`. `entry` is the entry's exact name (matched case-insensitively, surrounding spaces ignored), or its id with `byId: true`; a value that looks like an id is still taken as a name without `byId`.

byId.description: `entry` is an entry id, not a name (CLI: --by-id).

entry.description: Library entry name, or its id with byId.

name.description: The new plugin's name, at most 200 characters; the entry's name if omitted.

name: library_add
title: Add library entry as plugin
